verdict.rationale: Zero ships a documented MCP server (MCP.md) exposing tools to read threads, search/filter mail, ask questions about mailbox content, compose with AI assistance, create/send drafts, and delete/label emails — covering the full read-triage-draft-send loop for any MCP-capable agent like Claude.
